paragraphs: Hi, I'm Chris Tartaro, and I'm the Sketch Director for ***The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon***. Before that, I worked on ***Late Night with Jimmy Fallon***, which is where I won a Primetime Emmy for editing this [***Glee*** parody](https://vimeo.com/1241310840). Earlier, I was a freelance editor in the New York comedy world, working on Adult Swim shows like ***Xavier: Renegade Angel*** and ***Delocated***. I was also at MTV, where I worked on ***Wonder Showzen*** and ***Human Giant***.
I'm also in a band with my good friend John Haskell. We're called BlazerDog, but there was already a band with that name, so we changed the spelling to blazrdog. Feel free to mispronounce it.
